question.worked_solution:
First, we convert the given probability into a cumulative probability:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X<-3)=0.6915\,⇒\,P(X\le -3)=0.6915\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we transform to a standard normal random variable by $z$-scoring:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X\le -3) & =0.6915 \\ P\,(Z\le \frac{-3-(-4)}{\sigma }) & =0.6915 \\ Φ\,(\frac{1}{\sigma }) & =0.6915 \\ \frac{1}{\sigma } & ={Φ}^{-1}(0.6915)\end{aligned}
$$

According to the table, we have

$$
Φ(0.50)=0.6915\,⇒\,{Φ}^{-1}(0.6915)=0.50.
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{\sigma } & =0.50 \\ \sigma  & =2\end{aligned}
$$

Finally,

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sigma }^{2}={2}^{2}=4.\end{aligned}
$$
